title: WebGPU immediates, external textures and MediaStreamTrack speech
blurb: Three experiments in one page: binding a GPUTextureView from a drawable DOM card straight to a WGSL texture_external slot alongside a video, pushing per-card uniforms with pass.setImmediateData(), and feeding a video's audio track into SpeechRecognition.start(track) to drive an editable DOM caption banner in a 2D canvas.
question: Can one WGSL texture_external shader sample both a video and a drawn DOM element, can pass.setImmediateData() drive four warped DOM cards with zero uniform buffers, and can SpeechRecognition.start(track) write live captions straight into a drawn DOM banner?
result: Not verified in a browser yet; each demo reports the exact API route your browser takes and falls back when a feature is missing.
